story.title: Hayden Panettiere's Death Ruled Accidental Overdose Involving Fentanyl and Other Drugs
story.summary: Hayden Panettiere's death has been officially ruled an accidental overdose caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl. The Greenville County Coroner's Office confirmed the findings, stating that the actress had a mix of substances in her system at the time of her death.

explore_lenses.label: What did the coroner establish about her death?
explore_lenses.title: Official finding: accidental multi-drug overdose
explore_lenses.summary: The Greenville County Coroner’s Office determined that Panettiere, 36, died from an accidental overdose involving multiple drugs. The finding is based on the coroner’s investigation and autopsy; the autopsy found no contributing trauma.

claims.text: The coroner ruled the manner of death accidental and identified fentanyl, 4-ANPP (a fentanyl-production byproduct), alprazolam, methocarbamol and quetiapine in her system.
The coroner said the autopsy found no signs of trauma that contributed to the death.

points: The coroner ruled the manner of death accidental and identified fentanyl, 4-ANPP (a fentanyl-production byproduct), alprazolam, methocarbamol and quetiapine in her system.
The coroner said the autopsy found no signs of trauma that contributed to the death.
explore_lenses.uncertainty_note: The publicly reported coroner statement does not provide drug concentrations, timing of use, or the full autopsy and toxicology documentation.
explore_lenses.note: Researched context; forecasts and viewpoints are labeled and attributed.

explore_lenses.label: What does a multi-drug overdose finding mean?
explore_lenses.title: Presence of several drugs does not establish intent
explore_lenses.summary: An overdose involving several substances is medically consistent with polysubstance exposure, which can occur knowingly or unknowingly. The reported toxicology finding alone does not identify how each substance was obtained or whether Panettiere knew fentanyl was present.

claims.text: CDC defines polysubstance exposure as exposure to more than one drug, with or without the person’s knowledge, and says opioid-involved overdoses often involve additional opioid or non-opioid substances.

CDC says fentanyl may be present in illegally obtained drugs or counterfeit pills without a person’s knowledge; its presence in toxicology therefore cannot by itself establish intentional fentanyl use.
CDC notes that naloxone can reverse opioid overdoses, including fentanyl overdoses, and advises calling emergency services after it is given.

explore_lenses.label: What questions remain in the investigation?
explore_lenses.title: Police and DEA inquiries remain active
explore_lenses.summary: The coroner’s determination resolves the medical manner and cause of death but not the source or circumstances of the fentanyl. Greenville Police said its investigation continued, and reporting indicates the DEA is examining possible sourcing.

claims.text: Greenville Police confirmed on September 22 that its investigation was continuing; the family publicist told AP that the case remained complex and under investigation.
ABC News reported that the DEA was investigating whether the fentanyl originated in South Carolina or was brought from California.
The coroner’s office did not publicly release further details from the autopsy report, according to AP.

story_report.summary: Hayden Panettiere died at 36 after an accidental overdose involving multiple drugs, according to the Greenville County Coroner’s Office. Fentanyl was among the substances found in her system, and the coroner classified the manner of death as accidental. The finding establishes the official cause and manner of death, while leaving law enforcement inquiries into the origin of the fentanyl and other circumstances open.

sections.heading: Coroner Details Panettiere Toxicology Findings
sections.body: The coroner identified fentanyl, 4-ANPP, alprazolam, methocarbamol and quetiapine in Panettiere’s system. The autopsy found no signs of trauma that contributed to her death. Publicly reported information did not include drug concentrations, the timing of use or the complete autopsy and toxicology records.

sections.heading: Fentanyl Findings Do Not Establish Intent
sections.body: CDC guidance describes exposure to more than one drug as polysubstance exposure and notes that opioid-involved overdoses often involve additional substances. The agency also says fentanyl can be present in illegally obtained drugs or counterfeit pills without a person’s knowledge, meaning its detection alone does not establish intentional fentanyl use. No public evidence cited by the coroner establishes whether the drugs were prescribed, nonprescribed, knowingly combined or contaminated.

sections.heading: Panettiere Death Investigation Remains Open
sections.body: Greenville Police said Sept. 22 that its investigation was continuing, while the family’s publicist described the case as complex and under investigation. ABC News reported that the DEA was examining whether the fentanyl originated in South Carolina or was brought from California. The coroner’s office has not publicly released further autopsy details, according to AP.

unresolved.text: Investigators have not publicly determined the fentanyl’s source, how it entered the drug supply involved, or whether any related charges will be brought.

related_stories.title: Presley Gerber died at age 27
related_stories.summary: Presley Gerber, the 27-year-old son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and entrepreneur Rande Gerber, has died. A family spokesperson confirmed his death, which is currently being investigated as a suspected overdose. Gerber was found unresponsive at a rehabilitation facility in Los Angeles shortly after checking in.

related_stories.title: Investigation Requested into Juror in Lindsay Clancy Case
related_stories.summary: Lindsay Clancy's attorney has filed a motion requesting the court to investigate a juror who was a holdout during her murder trial, which ended in a mistrial. The motion seeks to examine the juror's cellphone use during deliberations and assess the accuracy of his responses on pre-trial questionnaires and during questioning by the judge.

related_stories.title: FIFA President Proposes Review of Governance Amid Investment Controversy
related_stories.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has called for a consultation to review the decision-making processes of the organization. This proposal follows significant backlash regarding a failed plan to introduce private investment into the World Cup. The German Football Association has criticized Infantino's initiative, suggesting it may be a tactic for his re-election.

related_stories.summary: Nearly 130 world leaders, including Taoiseach Micheál Martin, are gathering in New York for the United Nations General Assembly. Meanwhile, exiled Guinean opposition leader Cellou Dalein Diallo reported that his passport has been revoked, preventing him from attending the meetings.
